mapper.sql: site_id, for_ticks, repeat_interval_seconds, waiting_compare, waiting_threshold, active_compare, active_threshold, surge_wait_time_seconds
mapper.select: SELECT p.site_id, p.for_ticks, p.repeat_interval_seconds, p.waiting_compare, p.waiting_threshold, p.active_compare, p.active_threshold, p.surge_wait_time_seconds FROM alert_policy p JOIN site_info s ON s.site_id = p.site_id WHERE s.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alert_policy ( site_id, for_ticks, repeat_interval_seconds, waiting_compare, waiting_threshold, active_compare, active_threshold, surge_wait_time_seconds, created_by, created_at, created_ip, updated_by, updated_at, updated_ip ) VALUES ( #{siteId}, #{forTicks}, #{repeatIntervalSeconds}, #{waitingCompare}, #{waitingThreshold}, #{activeCompare}, #{activeThreshold}, #{surgeWaitTimeSeconds}, #{createdBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{createdIp}, #{updatedBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{updatedIp} ) ON CONFLICT (site_id) DO UPDATE SET for_ticks = EXCLUDED.for_ticks, repeat_interval_seconds = EXCLUDED.repeat_interval_seconds, waiting_compare = EXCLUDED.waiting_compare, waiting_threshold = EXCLUDED.waiting_threshold, active_compare = EXCLUDED.active_compare, active_threshold = EXCLUDED.active_threshold, surge_wait_time_seconds = EXCLUDED.surge_wait_time_seconds, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at, updated_ip = EXCLUDED.updated_ip
